title.zh-TW: 分段控制器與長條圖切換

summary.zh-TW: Day／Week／Month／Year 四段切換：藍色底色滑到選中的那一格，下方長條圖的每一根依序長到新的高度。方向鍵也能切換。
summary.en: Switch between Day, Week, Month and Year: the blue pill slides to the chosen segment and each chart bar grows to its new height in turn. Arrow keys work too.

text.zh-TW: 底色的寬度剛好是一格，xPercent 100 就是往右移「自己一整格」。第幾格就乘以幾，不用量位置。
text.en: The pill is exactly one segment wide, so xPercent 100 moves it one segment. Multiply by the index — no measuring needed.

text.zh-TW: 長條用 scaleY 從底部長高，不改 height。只動 transform，資料一換整排一起動也很順。
text.en: Bars grow from the bottom with scaleY rather than height. Only transforms change, so a whole row updating stays smooth.

text.zh-TW: 一個補間處理整排長條，每根的目標值用函式從資料裡拿，再加 stagger 讓它們由左到右依序長。
text.en: One tween drives every bar; a function pulls each target from the data, and stagger grows them left to right.

text.zh-TW: 分段控制在語意上是「多選一」，用 radiogroup 和 radio，方向鍵切換，讀屏軟體會唸出「第 2 個，共 4 個」。
text.en: A segmented control is semantically “choose one”, so it uses radiogroup and radio with arrow keys; screen readers announce “2 of 4”.
